explanation: Dutch settlers built Fort Amsterdam on Manhattan in 1625. Shah Jahan began the Taj Mahal after his wife died in 1631, and the complex took about 20 years to finish.

claims.text: Dutch settlers founded New Amsterdam, later New York, on Manhattan in 1625.
The Taj Mahal complex was completed around 1653.
Mumtaz Mahal, the wife of Shah Jahan, died in 1631, and work on the Taj Mahal began soon after.
Building the Taj Mahal complex took about 20 years.
